title: Health-ORSC-Bench: A Benchmark for Measuring Over-Refusal and Safety Completion in Health Context

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on a benchmark of benign, borderline health-related prompts (Health-ORSC-Bench) to measure the Over-Refusal Rate (ORR), identifying the tendency of safety-aligned models to be excessively cautious and incorrectly refuse safe queries.
